title: Sony just proved that ‘three OS updates’ doesn’t really mean anything
summary: Sony needs to offer a much stronger explanation for this.
body: TL;DR Sony has decided not to roll out the Android 17 update to the Xperia 10 VI. The company says it’s due to “technical limitations” of the Xperia 10 VI’s storage configuration. The Xperia 10 VI was promised three OS updates at launch, implying that it would be upgraded to Android 17. Sony started rolling out Android 17 to its flagship Xperia 1 VIII early last month. At the same time, the company released a list of phones eligible for the update, which surprisingly did not include the Xperia 10 VI. While that raised doubts about Sony’s plans for the phone, we now know that it’s simply never getting Android 17 . In a notice posted on its website, Sony confirmed that the Xperia 10 VI, released in 2024, will not be updated to Android 17. According to the company, “technical limitations due to the device’s storage configuration” prevent it from offering an Android 17 experience that Sony considers adequate.

Just seven years on, however, the Irish five-piece have transcended any limitations or naysayers who said a rock band could no longer move culture in the 21st century: Get a load of these lads. Dopamine Chamber is the band’s fifth album, and arrives in an ongoing purple patch for the group. Barely a year after their debut album came A Hero’s Death (2020), a moodier offering than their loquacious debut, and in 2022, they returned with Skinty Fia , their poppiest – and finest – collection to date. The band broke cover internationally with 2024’s Grammy-nominated Romance , but even then it was with an obtuse sound that channeled influences from grunge, nu-metal, and hip-hop. Sizzling tracks like “Starburster” and “Bug” travelled far and wide on platforms like TikTok, and brought them to their biggest audiences yet. title: ANBERNIC is quietly removing a controversial extra from its Android handhelds
summary: The company is dropping microSD card bundle options just days after facing accusations of distributing pirated games.
body: Credit: Hadlee Simons / Android Authority TL;DR ANBERNIC has started removing optional microSD card bundles from several handheld listings on its official store. The changes follow an ESA complaint accusing ANBERNIC of selling devices bundled with unauthorized games. ANBERNIC hasn’t confirmed a connection, but the move may be intended to head off further action against the company. ANBERNIC has had quite a week. After recently unveiling its Nintendo 3DS-inspired RG DDS handheld — whose potential pricing was leaked earlier today — the company found itself facing scrutiny over the copyrighted games allegedly bundled with its devices. Within days of the complaint coming to light, ANBERNIC now appears to be quietly removing the contentious microSD card options from its online store. As spotted by Retro Handhelds , several ANBERNIC handheld listings have lost the option to purchase additional microSD cards alongside the devices. The publication compared an archived version of the RG SP listing from August 14 with the current storefront, finding that only the 16GB option remains. title: Apple might just be Samsung’s best foldable salesperson yet
summary: Samsung just got a free marketing boost.
body: TL;DR Samsung’s Galaxy Z Fold 8 series is seeing strong demand, exceeding the company’s initial sales expectations. Samsung says demand for its latest foldables is up 16% since launch, while Google searches for Samsung foldables have surged 300% over the past month. Apple’s entry into the foldable market with the iPhone Duo could be driving more consumers to explore Samsung’s alternatives. There’s no denying that Samsung’s Galaxy Z Fold 8 series is having its moment. The South Korean tech giant’s decision to split the book-style segment into two — regular and widescreen — seems to be paying off. We reported that despite an overall decline in global smartphone shipments, strong demand for the Galaxy Z Fold 8 series has softened the blow for Samsung, and while the credit does go to Samsung for refining its lineup, there also appear to be some outside forces at play. Interestingly, one of those outside forces is Samsung’s biggest rival.

body: اليامي يعود تنفست جماهير الهلال الصعداء بعد اقتراب الظهير الأيمن حمد اليامي من العودة للمشاركة في المباريات الرسمية، بعد رحلة علاج طويلة وشاقة أبعدته عن الملاعب لأكثر من نصف عام. تذاكر مباريات دوري روشن السعودي اشتر تذكرتك الآن! وكشف صحيفة " الرياضية " السعودية أن اليامي وصل إلى الجاهزية التامة وفق البرنامج التأهيلي الذي خضع له خلال الفترة الماضية، وأصبح قرار مشاركته في المباريات المقبلة بيد الجهازين الفني والطبي. ويأتي هذا التطور بعد غياب دام نحو 205 أيام، منذ إصابته القوية في الركبة خلال مواجهة فريقه أمام التعاون ضمن الجولة العاشرة من دوري الموسم الماضي، والتي استدعت خضوعه لعملية جراحية دقيقة في "رضفة الركبة" في مارس الماضي. وكان الحساب الرسمي لنادي الهلال عبر منصة "إكس" قد بث جرعة من التفاؤل في نفوس جماهيره الإثنين الماضي، بعدما نشر لقطات لمشاركة اليامي في جزء من التدريبات الجماعية، في إشارة واضحة إلى تجاوزه للمراحل الحرجة من التأهيل واطمئنان الجهاز الطبي على سير تعافيه. على صعيد متصل، يعود لاعبو الفريق الأزرق إلى التدريبات مساء غدٍ الجمعة، بعد الراحة التي منحها الجهاز الفني بقيادة الإيطالي سيموني إنزاجي عقب العودة براً من الدوحة، بعد الفوز الثمين على السد القطري 2-0 في ثاني جولات دوري أبطال آسيا للنخبة. title: Fairphone shares when Fairbuds 2 US sales are set to begin
summary: The Fairbuds 2 have 7 user-replaceable components.
body: TL;DR Fairphone is known for its eco-friendly, repairable mobile hardware. In addition to its smartphones, the company has released Fairbuds earbuds and headphones. It’s now introducing its second-generation model, the Fairbuds 2. Being a responsible consumer is just so attractive these days, and the good news for anyone looking to take on that mantle is that we’ve got some great hardware options that make it easier than ever. Companies like Fairphone have been creating devices designed not to break and be replaced, but to support easy repairs, allowing us to seriously reduce our e-waste impact. We’ve been looking forward to the initial launch of the Fairbuds 2 repairable earbuds, and now that it’s finally arrived, we’re getting some fresh details about US sales. Right on schedule, Fairphone formally introduced the Fairbuds 2 yesterday. The earbuds, along with their case, are both smaller and lighter than the inaugural Fairbuds, and offer 50% better battery life. But those upgrades don’t mean forgetting about what makes these earbuds special, and this model breaks down into 7 replaceable parts for long-term maintenance.

body: TL;DR The REDMAGIC 12 Pro Plus launches today in China. It’s one of the first gaming phones to use Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6. Global availability will be announced on November 3, but getting US carrier support remains tricky. Our reliance on phones has made the demands placed on them higher every day, but perhaps none have to work as hard as a gaming phone . Today REDMAGIC is launching its 12 Pro Plus, and it’s among the first to use the powerful, just-released Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 . Qualcomm’s Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 is the first smartphone processor with a 5GHz CPU, helping the REDMAGIC 12 Pro Plus handle refresh rates in high-action sequences. title: Android’s Earthquake Alerts System is getting smarter about telling you to take action
summary: Hopefully you'll never see the update in action.
body: TL;DR Android’s Earthquake Alerts System is expanding to more regions: 200+, up from 98. Be Ready earthquake alert notifications will be getting an update “in the coming months.” Google says Android has delivered more than a billion individual earthquake alerts since 2021. Android’s built-in earthquake alerts are expanding to a lot more places. Google’s announced that the system that’s been available in 98 countries and regions to date is now available in more than 200. The alerts themselves are getting an upgrade, too. Google made the announcements in a blog post that wraps up a handful of earthquake alert updates. The post says that the new regions where earthquake alerts are now available includes Panama and Guatemala, though as of publication, the feature’s support documentation hasn’t yet been updated to include the full list.

body: A NASA Dynamic Aviation A200 aircraft will conduct low-flying research flights over farmland near Transit, Texas, from Thursday, Oct. 22, through Monday, Nov. 9. These flights will measure gaseous and particulate emissions from animal feeding operations. A photo of the Dynamic Aviation A200 aircraft, which will conduct low-flying research flights over farmland near Transit, Texas, to measure emissions in October and November 2026. Dynamic Aviation Agricultural emissions represent an important and understudied part of Earth’s land and atmosphere systems. The FarmFlux mission will deploy more than a dozen sensors to measure ozone, methane, ammonia, particulates, and other pollutants rising from crop lands and livestock farms and their interaction with the Earth’s atmosphere. The mission is jointly led by NASA’s Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, Maryland; Colorado State University; and Boston University. Additional low-altitude research flights with a NASA P-3 Orion aircraft are scheduled for the March to July 2027 growing season in the Midwest and California’s Central Valley with a focus on cropland. title: Is your Pixel recording unusually quiet audio? You’re not alone
summary: Still dealing with microphone issues first reported back in 2024.
body: TL;DR Several Pixel owners are reporting unusually low microphone volume when recording audio/video natively or via certain apps. Similar complaints date back to 2024 and span multiple Pixel generations, including the latest Pixel 10 series. Google appears to be aware of the complaints but hasn’t publicly acknowledged a widespread issue, and there’s no confirmed fix yet. Apart from offering one of the best software experiences in the Android smartphone ecosystem, Google’s Pixel line is also known for its impressive camera capabilities . However, what good is a high-res video recording if you can barely hear anything when you play it back? That’s exactly the frustration that a lot of Pixel owners are (and have been) dealing with. This isn’t a brand new issue, but it is resurfacing now. Reports about Pixel microphones recording audio that’s too quiet to hear can be traced back to 2024, and similar microphone problems appear to have continued to plague users since.

title: Qualcomm’s lengthy legal battle with Arm nets it $2 (not a typo) in damages

body: TL;DR A Delaware jury has awarded Qualcomm $2 in damages in its legal fight with Arm. The jury sided with Qualcomm on two counts, and with Arm on five counts. The legal battle will now go to a US federal judge who will resolve several other issues. Qualcomm and Arm have been involved in a series of legal battles over several issues over the last couple of years. Since Qualcomm acquired Nuvia back in 2021, Arm has threatened to cancel Qualcomm’s architecture licensing agreement (ALA), and Qualcomm has filed lawsuits against Arm. Yes, that’s not a typo.

Google Play appears to have the most complete implementation so far, while many other Google support pages still don’t show the feature. Google has found increasingly creative places to put Gemini , from apps and search experiences to Android itself . Now, it looks like the company wants AI handling another job that has traditionally meant digging through help articles: figuring out why a Google product is misbehaving. Android Authority contributor AssembleDebug spotted a new Ask Google Help experience on Google Play’s support pages. title: Samsung Galaxy phones can’t tell if they’re connected to Bluetooth or not

You may not always notice it, but the volume slider on your Galaxy phone conveys more information than just the volume level. Whether you’re listening to music through your earbuds or blasting it through your Bluetooth speakers, there will be a little symbol at the bottom of the panel that lets you know what your phone is connected to. However, a new bug is causing issues with this indicator. Samsung Galaxy phone users ( 1 , 2 , 3 ) are experiencing a strange glitch affecting the volume panel. The app, from a developer named “Hizbartech,” even paid its way to the top of the search results for “Chrome.” Google has since removed the app, but it raises questions about the Play Store’s review and ad practices. Google talks a big game about trying to keep the Android ecosystem safe and secure. The company recently started cracking down on sideloading apps because malicious actors can easily create fake apps and trick users into installing them. Instead, Google wants users to install apps directly from the Play Store. The idea is that installing apps from the Play Store pretty much guarantees you won’t install a fake or malicious app. However, Google doesn’t seem to be doing a stellar job of keeping the Play Store safe, either.

title: Some Googlebooks OLED screens can’t display true black, but a fix is coming
summary: The engineering team has identified the cause and says a fix is already in the works.
body: TL;DR Some Googlebooks owners are reporting that their OLED displays show dark gray instead of true black once Googlebook OS loads. The issue appears across multiple Acer and Lenovo models, and the presence of proper blacks during boot/setup points to a software-related problem. Google says its engineering team has identified the root cause and is working to get a fix out very soon. Google has been moving quickly to sand down Googlebook OS’ rougher edges.
